limitations: Same AI agent implemented and inspected detector code and had previously seen aggregate evaluation metrics. This is not an independent or fully blinded human validation.
All three labels are absent in this sample; sensitivity/recall on natural positives cannot be estimated.
Wrong final answers, omitted executions, and valid calls rejected by environment business rules are outside these three label definitions.
method: AI read the ordered emitted calls, assistant content, execution errors and latencies from all 100 blinded transcripts. No per-run findings or verifier success were consulted before saving these judgments. Labels are model judgments, not generated by detector functions.
